sentences.zh: 長興三年春正月癸未朔，帝御明堂殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: In the third year of Changxing, spring, first month, guiwei new moon: the Emperor took the Bright Hall palace to receive court congratulations; guards and retinue were as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei new moon of the first month in spring of Changxing 3 Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Bright Hall with full ceremonial guard.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，陝州節度使安從進移鎮延州。

translations.literal: On dinghai Shazhou military commissioner An Congjin was transferred to garrison Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai An Congjin of Shazhou moved to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，遣邠州節度使藥彥稠、靈武節度使康福率步騎七千往方渠討党項之叛者。

translations.literal: On jichou Binzhou military commissioner Yao Yanchou and Lingwu military commissioner Kang Fu were sent leading seven thousand foot and horse to Fangqu to suppress the Tangut rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Yao Yanchou of Bin and Kang Fu of Lingwu led seven thousand troops to Fangqu against Tangut rebels.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以前北京副留守呂夢奇為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: On gengyin former Beijing vice regent Lü Mengqi was made Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin former Beijing vice regent Lü Mengqi became vice revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以前彰國軍留後孫漢韶為利州節度使，充西面行營副部署兼步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On xinmao former Zhangguo Army regent Sun Hanshao was made Lizhou military commissioner, filling western campaign deputy marshal and concurrent foot-army commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Sun Hanshao of Zhangguo became Lizhou commissioner, western campaign deputy marshal, and foot-army commander.

sentences.zh: 庚子，契丹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On gengzi the Khitan sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Khitan presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，秦王從榮加開府儀同三司、兼中書令。

translations.literal: On xinchou Qin Wang Congrong was advanced to Palatial Chamberlain with Parity of Three Honours and concurrent Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Prince Li Congrong was made palatial chamberlain with three-honour parity and concurrent secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔選人文解不合式樣，罪在發解官吏，舉人落第，次年免取文解。

translations.literal: On wushen an edict: civil service candidates' qualification essays not matching the prescribed form—the fault lies with the dispatching officials; failed candidates the next year are exempt from submitting qualification essays.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict blamed dispatching officials when candidates' essays failed format and exempted failed candidates from essays the next year.

sentences.zh: 中書門下奏：「請親王官至兼侍中、中書令，則與見任宰臣分班定位，宰臣居左，諸親王居右。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "Request that when princes reach the rank of concurrent Vice Director or Secretariat Director, they form separate rows with incumbent chancellors for positioning—chancellors on the left, all princes on the right.
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat asked that princes who held concurrent vice director or secretariat director rank stand in a separate row to the right of sitting chancellors on the left.

sentences.zh: 如親王及諸使守侍中、中書令，亦分行居右，其餘使相依舊。

translations.literal: If princes and various commissioners hold Vice Director or Secretariat Director, they too form rows on the right; the rest of commissioners follow the old rule.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and commissioners with those titles would also stand right; other commissioners unchanged.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 渤海、回鶻、吐蕃遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Bohai, Uighur, and Tibetan envoys came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Bohai, Uighurs, and Tibet sent tributary envoys.

sentences.zh: 大理正張居錄上言：「所頒諸州新定格式、律令，請委逐處各差法直官一人，專掌檢討。

translations.literal: Grand justice Zhang Jilu memorialized: "The newly fixed regulations and statutes issued to all prefectures—request that each place appoint one legal examiner to specialize in checking them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand justice Zhang Jilu asked each prefecture to appoint a legal examiner to check newly issued regulations and statutes.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，製晉國夫人夏氏追冊為皇后。

translations.literal: Second month yimao: Lady of Jin state Xia was posthumously enfeoffed as empress by decree.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on yimao Xia, lady of Jin, was posthumously made empress.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，幸龍門。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Emperor visited Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Mingzong visited Longmen.

sentences.zh: 詔故皇城使李從璨可贈太保。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously granted former Imperial City commissioner Li Congcan Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Li Congcan was posthumously made grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 詔出選門官，罷任後周年方許擬議，自於所司投狀磨勘送中書。

translations.literal: An edict: outgoing Selection Gate officials—after leaving office a full year before nomination may be considered; they themselves submit credentials to their office for polishing review and forwarding to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Selection Gate alumni had to wait one year after leaving office before nomination, submitting credentials through their office to the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 又詔罷城南稻田務，以其所費多而所收少，欲復其水利，資於民間碾磑故也。

translations.literal: Also an edict abolished the southern-city rice-field office, because its costs were many and receipts few, wishing to restore its waterworks for the people's millstones.
translations.idiomatic: The southern-city rice-field office was abolished to restore waterworks for private mills after costs outweighed revenue.

sentences.zh: 秦州奏：「州界三縣之外，別有一十一鎮人戶，係鎮將征科，欲隨其便，宜復置隴城、天水二縣以隸之。

translations.literal: Qin prefecture memorialized: "Beyond the three counties of the prefecture's border, another eleven fortified-town households are taxed by town commandants; wishing convenience for them, it is fitting to restore Longcheng and Tianshui two counties to attach them.
translations.idiomatic: Qinzhou asked to restore Longcheng and Tianshui counties for eleven towns taxed by commandants outside its three counties.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: 」An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸至德宮。

translations.literal: On jiazi the Emperor visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Mingzong visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue.

sentences.zh: 以右衛大將軍高居貞為右監門衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Right Guard senior general Gao Juzhen was made Right Gate Guard supreme general.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Juzhen became right gate guard supreme general.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以前華州節度使李從昶為左驍衛大將軍，以前夔州節度使安崇阮為右驍衛大將軍，以前新州節度使翟璋為右領軍上將軍，以右領軍上將軍羅周敬為右威衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu former Huazhou military commissioner Li Congchang was made Left Martial Valiant senior general; former Kuizhou military commissioner An Chongruan was made Right Martial Valiant senior general; former Xinzhou military commissioner Zhai Zhang was made Right Army of the Lead supreme general; Right Army of the Lead supreme general Luo Zhoujing was made Right Majestic Guard supreme general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Li Congchang, An Chongruan, Zhai Zhang, and Luo Zhoujing received senior guard promotions.

sentences.zh: 辛未，中書奏：「請依石經文字刻《九經》印板。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Secretariat memorialized: "Request to cut printing blocks of the 《Nine Classics》 according to the stone classic characters.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the secretariat asked to carve 《Nine Classics》 blocks from the stone classic text.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：長興三年二月，中書門下奏：「請依石經文字刻《九經》印板，敕令國子監集博士儒徒，將西京石經本，各以所業本經，廣為抄寫，仔細看讀，然後雇召能雕字匠人，各部隨帙刻印板，廣頒天下。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: In the second month of the third year of Changxing, the Secretariat memorialized: "Please cut printing blocks of the 《Nine Classics》 according to the stone classic characters; order the Directorate of Education to gather doctorate scholars, take the Western Capital stone classic copies, each according to his specialty copy his classic broadly, read carefully, then hire skilled carving craftsmen, each section following fascicles carve blocks, and distribute widely throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 records the secretariat asking to carve 《Nine Classics》 blocks from the Western Capital stone classics through the Directorate of Education for empire-wide distribution.

sentences.zh: 如諸色人要寫經書，並請依所印刻本，不得更使雜本交錯。

translations.literal: If persons of various sorts wish to copy classics, all please rely on the carved edition and must not let miscellaneous copies intermingle.
translations.idiomatic: Copyists were to use only the official carved edition, not mixed texts.

sentences.zh: 」《愛日齋叢鈔》云：《通鑒》載：「後唐長興三年二月辛未，初令國子監校定《九經》，雕印賣之。

translations.literal: "The 《Miscellany of the Airi Studio》 says: the 《Comprehensive Mirror》 records: "In the third year of Changxing of Later Tang, second month xinwei, for the first time ordered the Directorate of Education to collate the 《Nine Classics》, carve and print them for sale.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Miscellany of the Airi Studio》 cites the 《Comprehensive Mirror》 on Changxing 3, second month xinwei, ordering the Directorate of Education to collate and sell printed 《Nine Classics》.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「自唐末以來，所在學校廢絕，蜀毋昭裔出私財百萬營學館，且請板刻《九經》，蜀主從之。

translations.literal: "It also says: "Since late Tang times, local schools everywhere were abandoned; Shu's Wu Zhaoyi expended private wealth of a million to establish a teaching hall, and also requested block-printing the 《Nine Classics》; the Shu ruler approved it.
translations.idiomatic: It also notes that after late-Tang school collapse Wu Zhaoyi of Shu spent a million in private funds on a academy and 《Nine Classics》 blocks with Shu approval.

sentences.zh: 由是蜀中文學復盛。

translations.literal: Hence literary culture in Shu again flourished.
translations.idiomatic: Literary culture in Shu revived.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「唐明宗之世，宰相馮道、李愚請令判國子監田敏校定《九經》，刻板印賣，從之。

translations.literal: "It also says: "In Mingzong's era, chancellors Feng Dao and Li Yu requested ordering Acting Director of the Directorate of Education Tian Min to collate the 《Nine Classics》, carve blocks and print for sale—it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong's chancellors Feng Dao and Li Yu had Tian Min of the Directorate of Education collate and print the 《Nine Classics》, which was approved.

sentences.zh: 後周廣順三年六月丁巳，板成，獻之。

translations.literal: In Later Zhou's third year of Guangshun, sixth month dingsi, the blocks were completed and presented.
translations.idiomatic: The blocks were finished and presented in Later Zhou Guangshun 3, sixth month dingsi.

sentences.zh: 由是雖亂世，《九經》傳布甚廣。

translations.literal: Hence even in chaotic times the 《Nine Classics》 spread very widely.
translations.idiomatic: Even in chaos the 《Nine Classics》 spread widely.

sentences.zh: 王仲言《揮麈錄》云：毋昭裔貧賤時，嘗借《文選》於交遊間，其人有難色，發憤，異日若貴，當板以鏤之遺學者。

translations.literal: Wang Zhongyan's 《Whisk Records》 says: when Wu Zhaoyi was poor and lowly, he once borrowed the 《Wen Xuan》 among friends; that person showed difficulty; he swore in anger that if one day noble he would block-carve it to leave scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhongyan's 《Whisk Records》 says Wu Zhaoyi, rebuffed borrowing the 《Wen Xuan》, vowed to carve it for scholars if he rose.

sentences.zh: 後仕王蜀為宰相，遂踐其言，刊之，印行書籍，創見於此。

translations.literal: Later he served King Shu as chancellor and then fulfilled his words, publishing it; printed books first appear here.
translations.idiomatic: As Shu chancellor he fulfilled that vow, the earliest printed books on record.

sentences.zh: 事載陶嶽《五代史補》。

translations.literal: The matter is recorded in Tao Yue's 《Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties》.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Yue's 《Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties》 records it.

sentences.zh: 後唐平蜀，明宗命太學博士李鍔書《五經》，仿其制作，刊板於國子監，為監中刻書之始。

translations.literal: When Later Tang pacified Shu, Mingzong ordered Grand Academy doctorate Li Gao to write the 《Five Classics》, copying their production, carving blocks at the Directorate of Education—this was the Directorate's beginning of carved books.
translations.idiomatic: After pacifying Shu Mingzong had Li Gao write and carve the 《Five Classics》 at the Directorate of Education—the start of its printing.

sentences.zh: 《猗覺寮雜記》云：雕印文字，唐以前無之，唐末，益州始有墨板，後唐方鏤《九經》，悉收人間所有經史，以鏤板為正。

translations.literal: The 《Miscellaneous Record of the Yi Studio》 says: carved printed characters—none before Tang; late Tang, Yizhou first had ink blocks; Later Tang then carved the 《Nine Classics》, all collecting people's extant classics and histories to make the carved edition standard.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Miscellaneous Record of the Yi Studio》 says printing began late Tang at Yizhou with ink blocks; Later Tang standardized the 《Nine Classics》 from collected texts.

sentences.zh: 見《兩朝國史》。

translations.literal: See the 《State History of the Two Reigns》.
translations.idiomatic: This is noted in the 《State History of the Two Reigns》.

sentences.zh: 此則印書已始自唐末矣。

translations.literal: Thus printed books already began from late Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Printing thus began in late Tang.

sentences.zh: 案《柳氏家訓》序：中和三年癸卯夏，鑾輿在蜀之三年也，餘為中書舍人，旬休，閱書於重城之東南，其書多陰陽雜記、占夢相宅、九宮五緯之流。

translations.literal: Examining the preface to the 《Family Instructions of Master Liu》: in the third summer year of Zhonghe guimao, the imperial carriage was in Shu's third year; I was Secretariat drafting officer; on rest days I read books southeast of the inner city; the books were mostly yin-yang miscellanies, dream divination, house divination, nine palaces five latitudes and such.
translations.idiomatic: Liu's 《Family Instructions》 preface describes Zhonghe guimao in Shu with block-printed divination and elementary books already common.

sentences.zh: 又有字書小學，率雕板，印紙浸染，不可盡曉。

translations.literal: There were also character books and elementary learning, mostly carved blocks, printed paper so soaked it could not all be understood.
translations.idiomatic: Character books and primers were mostly blocks, though ink so soaked pages they were hard to read.

sentences.zh: 葉氏《燕語》正以此證刻書不始於馮道，而沈存中又謂板印書籍，唐人尚未盛行為之，自馮瀛王始印《五經》，自後典籍皆為板本。

translations.literal: Ye's 《Yan Talk》 uses this to prove printing did not begin with Feng Dao; Shen Cunzhong also said block-printed books in Tang were not yet widely done—it began with Chancellor Feng carving the 《Five Classics》, after which all classics became block editions.
translations.idiomatic: Ye's 《Yan Talk》 and Shen Cunzhong disagree whether Feng Dao or earlier Tang printing began the 《Five Classics》 block tradition.

sentences.zh: 大概唐末漸有印書，特未盛行，後人遂以為始於蜀也。

translations.literal: Generally late Tang gradually had printed books, just not yet widespread; later people thus thought it began in Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Late Tang printing was still rare, so later writers credited Shu.

sentences.zh: 當五季亂離之際，經籍方有托而流布於四方，天之不絕斯文，信矣。）〉

translations.literal: In the Five Dynasties' age of chaotic separation, the classics finally had support to flow to the four directions; Heaven's not cutting off cultured writing—truly so.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Yet in Five Dynasties chaos the classics still spread widely—Heaven did not abandon learning.)〉

sentences.zh: 甲戌，靈武奏，都指揮使許審環等謀亂伏誅。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Lingwu memorialized that commander-in-chief Xu Shenhuan and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Lingwu reported commander Xu Shenhuan's plot and execution.

sentences.zh: 藥彥稠奏，誅党項阿埋等十族，與康福入白魚穀追襲叛黨，獲大首領六人、諸羌二千餘人、孳畜數千，及先劫掠到回鶻物貨。

translations.literal: Yao Yanchou memorialized that ten Tangut clans including Amai were executed; with Kang Fu he entered White Fish Valley pursuing rebels, capturing six great chiefs, more than two thousand various Qiang, thousands of livestock, and goods earlier plundered from the Uighurs.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yanchou reported executing ten Tangut clans; with Kang Fu he took six chiefs, two thousand Qiang, livestock, and plundered Uighur goods at White Fish Valley.

sentences.zh: 詔彥稠軍士，所獲並令自收，勿得箕斂。

translations.literal: An edict: Yao Yanchou's soldiers—all booty let them keep themselves; must not rake and levy.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers could keep their booty without command levy.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以前河中節度使索自通為鄜州節度使。

translations.literal: On jimao former Hedong military commissioner Suo Zitong was made Bozhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Suo Zitong of Hedong became Bozhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 懷化軍節度使李讚華進契丹地圖。

translations.literal: Huaihua Army military commissioner Li Zanhua presented a Khitan territorial map.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zanhua of Huaihua presented a Khitan map.

sentences.zh: 詔司天台，除密奏留中外，應奏曆象、雲物、水旱，及十曜細行、諸州災祥，宜並報史館，以備編修。

translations.literal: An edict to the Directorate of Astronomy: except confidential memorials kept within and without, all memorials on calendars, celestial phenomena, clouds, floods and droughts, and the ten luminaries' fine courses, and all prefectures' omens, should also be reported to the History Office for compilation.
translations.idiomatic: The astronomy directorate had to report calendars, omens, and disasters to the History Office except confidential memorials.

sentences.zh: 壬午，藥彥稠進回鶻可汗先送秦王金裝胡錄，為党項所掠，至是得之以獻。

translations.literal: On renwu Yao Yanchou presented the Uighur khan's gold-mounted barbarian register earlier sent to the Qin Wang, plundered by Tanguts, now recovered and offered.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Yao Yanchou returned a Uighur gold register plundered from Li Congrong and recovered from Tanguts.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「先詔所獲令軍士自收，今何進也？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "The prior edict said booty let soldiers keep themselves—why present it now?
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong said an earlier edict let soldiers keep booty—why was this presented?

sentences.zh: 」令彥稠卻與獲者。

translations.literal: 」He ordered Yao Yanchou to return it to the captors.
translations.idiomatic: 」Yao Yanchou had to return it to the captors.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，契丹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Third month jiashen: the Khitan sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the third month the Khitan presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 靈武軍將裴昭隱等二人與進奏官阮順之隱官馬一匹，有司論罪合抵法，帝曰：「不可以一馬殺三人命。

translations.literal: Lingwu army officers Pei Zhaoyin and two others, with memorial envoy Ruan Shunzhi, concealed one official horse; the relevant office judged the crime merited legal penalty; the Emperor said: "One must not kill three lives over one horse.
translations.idiomatic: Three men faced death for concealing one horse; Mingzong said three lives must not die for one horse.

sentences.zh: 」笞而釋之。

translations.literal: 」They were flogged and released.
translations.idiomatic: 」They were beaten and freed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，西京奏，百姓侯可洪於楊廣城內掘得宿藏玉四團進納。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Western Capital memorialized that commoner Hou Kehong at Yang Guang city dug up and presented four hoarded jade masses from a buried cache.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the Western Capital reported Hou Kehong unearthed four jade hoards at Yang Guang city.

sentences.zh: 賜可洪二百緡、絹二百匹。

translations.literal: Kehong was granted two hundred strings of cash and two hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Kehong received two hundred strings of cash and two hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以前鄜州節度使孫璋卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On gengzi former Bozhou military commissioner Sun Zhang died—court suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Sun Zhang of Bozhou died and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，帝顧謂宰臣曰：「春雨稍多，久未晴霽，何也？

translations.literal: On guimao the Emperor looked at the chancellors and said: "Spring rain is rather much; long without clearing—why?
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Mingzong asked the chancellors why spring rains would not clear.

sentences.zh: 」馮道對曰：「水旱作沴，雖是天之常道，然季春行秋令，臣之罪也。

translations.literal: 」Feng Dao replied: "Flood and drought as calamities, though Heaven's constant way, yet spring executing autumn commands is my fault.
translations.idiomatic: 」Feng Dao said floods and drought were Heaven's way but spring acting like autumn was his fault.

sentences.zh: 更望陛下廣敷恩宥，久雨無妨於聖政也。

translations.literal: I further hope Your Majesty broadly bestow gracious pardon—prolonged rain is no harm to sagely government.
translations.idiomatic: He asked Mingzong to grant broad amnesty, saying long rain would not harm rule.

sentences.zh: 」丁未，以神捷、神威、雄武、廣捷已下指揮改為左右羽林軍，置四十指揮，每十指揮立為一軍，軍置都指揮使一人。

translations.literal: 」On dingwei the Divine Swift, Divine Majestic, Martial Valor, Broad Swift and below commands were changed to Left and Right Feathered Forest Armies, establishing forty commands; every ten commands form one army; each army sets one commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: 」On dingwei lower guard commands became left and right feathered forest armies of forty commands, ten per army with a commander.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，帝觀稼於近郊。

translations.literal: On gengxu the Emperor viewed the crops in the nearby suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Mingzong inspected crops near the capital.

sentences.zh: 民有父子三人同挽犁耕者，帝閔之，賜耕牛三頭。

translations.literal: Among the people a father and three sons together pulled a plow to till; the Emperor pitied them and granted three plow oxen.
translations.idiomatic: Pitying a father and three sons plowing together, he gave them three oxen.

sentences.zh: 高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Goryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo sent tributary envoys.

sentences.zh: 以右領軍上將軍翟璋為右羽林統軍，以前安州留後周知裕為左神武統軍。

translations.literal: Right Army of the Lead supreme general Zhai Zhang was made Right Feathered Forest commander-in-chief; former Anzhou regent Zhou Zhiyu was made Left Divine Martial commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Zhang became right feathered forest commander and Zhou Zhiyu left divine martial commander.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，詔諸道節度使未帶使相及防禦、團練使、刺史，班位居檢校官高者上為，如檢校官同，以先授者為上，前資在見任之下。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month jiayin: an edict—circuit military commissioners not bearing commissioner-chancellor rank and defense, training, and prefectural commissioners—court row positioning: those above in acting rank stand higher; if acting rank the same, earlier appointment is higher; prior service ranks below current office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the fourth month an edict set court row order by acting rank, date of appointment, and prior service.

sentences.zh: 新羅王金溥遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: Silla king Jin Pu sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Silla's Jin Pu sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 戊午，中書奏：「 準敕重定三京、諸道州府地望次第者。

translations.literal: On wuwu the Secretariat memorialized: " Per the edict to re-fix the precedence of the three capitals and all circuits' prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the secretariat proposed reordering capital and circuit precedence under a new edict.

sentences.zh: 舊制以王者所都之地為上，今都洛陽，請以河南道為上，關內道為第二，河東道為第三，餘依舊制。

translations.literal: Old rule took the king's residence as highest; now the capital is Luoyang—request Henan circuit as highest, Guannei second, Hedong third; the rest follow old rule.
translations.idiomatic: With Luoyang as capital Henan circuit should rank first, then Guannei and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 其五府，按《十道圖》，以鳳翔為首，河中、成都、江陵、興元為次。

translations.literal: The five prefectures, according to the 《Ten Circuits Map》, take Fengxiang as head, Hedong, Chengdu, Jiangling, and Xingyuan next.
translations.idiomatic: Among five prefectures Fengxiang led Hedong, Chengdu, Jiangling, and Xingyuan per the 《Ten Circuits Map》.

sentences.zh: 中興初，升魏州為興唐府，鎮州為真定府，望升二府在五府之上，合為七州，餘依舊制。

translations.literal: At the dynasty's restoration Weizhou was advanced to Xingtang prefecture and Zhenzhou to Zhending prefecture; in precedence both prefectures rise above the five prefectures, together seven prefectures; the rest follow old rule.
translations.idiomatic: Xingtang and Zhending prefectures ranked above the five-prefecture group for seven leading prefectures total.

sentences.zh: 又天下舊有八大都督府，以靈州為首，陝、幽、魏、揚、潞、鎮、徐為次，其魏、鎮已升為七府兼具員內，相次升越、杭、福、潭等州為都督，望以十大都督府為額，仍據升降次第，以陝為首，餘依舊制。

translations.literal: Also the realm formerly had eight great protector-general prefectures, Lingzhou as head, Shaan, You, Wei, Yang, Lu, Zhen, and Xu next; Wei and Zhen already rose into the seven prefectures and share quota within; successively advance Yue, Hang, Fu, Tan and other prefectures as protector-generals—request the ten great protector-general prefectures as quota, still according to rise and fall precedence, Shaan as head; the rest follow old rule.
translations.idiomatic: Eight protector-general seats led by Lingzhou were expanded to ten, with Shaan first after elevating Yue, Hang, Fu, and Tan.

sentences.zh: 《十道圖》有大都護，請以安東大都護為首。

translations.literal: The 《Ten Circuits Map》 has great protector-generals—request Andong great protector-general as head.
translations.idiomatic: Andong great protector-general should head that list on the 《Ten Circuits Map》.

sentences.zh: 防禦、團練等使，自來升降極多，今具見在，其員依新定《十道圖》以次第為定。

translations.literal: Defense and training commissioners and such have always had very many promotions and demotions; now listing those currently in office, their quota follows the newly fixed 《Ten Circuits Map》 by precedence as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Defense and training commissioners now in office were ranked by the new 《Ten Circuits Map》 quota.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 契丹累遣使求歸則剌、惕隱等，幽州趙德鈞奏請不俞允。

translations.literal: The Khitan repeatedly sent envoys requesting return of Zela, Tiyin, and others; Youzhou Zhao Dejun memorialized requesting not to grant it.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan envoys repeatedly asked for Zela, Tiyin, and others; Zhao Dejun of Youzhou asked to refuse.

sentences.zh: 帝顧問侍臣，亦以為不可與。

translations.literal: The Emperor consulted attendant ministers; they too thought they could not be given.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong consulted attendants, who also opposed returning them.

sentences.zh: 帝意欲歸之，會冀州刺史楊檀罷郡至闕，帝問其事，奏曰：「此輩來援王都，謀危社稷，陛下寬慈，貸其生命。

translations.literal: The Emperor wished to return them; it happened that Jizhou prefect Yang Tan left his prefecture and reached court; the Emperor asked about the matter; he memorialized: "These men came to aid Wang Du, plotting to endanger the state; Your Majesty's broad mercy spared their lives.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong favored return until Yang Tan of Jizhou said they had aided Wang Du against the state and mercy should not send them back.

sentences.zh: 苟若歸之，必復向南放箭，既知中國事情，為患深矣。

translations.literal: If returned, they will surely again shoot arrows south; knowing China's affairs, the harm would be deep.
translations.idiomatic: Returned, they would raid south again with dangerous knowledge of the realm.

sentences.zh: 」帝然之。

translations.literal: 」The Emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: 」Mingzong agreed.

sentences.zh: 既而隻遣則骨舍利隨來使歸蕃，不欲全拒其請也。

translations.literal: Shortly after, only Zegu Shelixi was sent back to the barbarians with the returning envoy, not wishing fully to reject their request.
translations.idiomatic: He later sent only Zegu Shelixi back with the envoy to avoid fully refusing the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 詔贈皇后曹氏曾祖父母已下為太傅、太尉、太師、國夫人，淑妃王氏曾祖父母已下為太子太保、太傅、太師、國夫人。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously granted Empress Cao's great-grandparents and below as Grand Tutor, Grand Commandant, Grand Preceptor, and Ladies of the State; Virtuous Consort Wang's great-grandparents and below as Crown Prince Grand Guardian, Grand Tutor, Grand Preceptor, and Ladies of the State.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Cao's and Virtuous Consort Wang's forebears received posthumous grand tutor, commandant, preceptor, and lady ranks.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，前樞密使、驃騎大將軍馬紹宏卒。

translations.literal: On renxu former Privy Commissioner and Flying Cavalry general Ma Shaohong died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu former privy commissioner Ma Shaohong died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以懷化軍節度使李讚華為滑州節度使。

translations.literal: On guihai Huaihua Army military commissioner Li Zanhua was made Huazhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Li Zanhua of Huaihua became Huazhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 初，帝欲以讚華為藩鎮，範延光等奏，以為不可。

translations.literal: Earlier the Emperor wished to make Zanhua a frontier commissioner; Fan Yanguang and others memorialized that it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong had wanted Li Zanhua as a frontier commissioner until Fan Yanguang objected.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「吾與其先人約為兄弟，故讚華來附。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "I with his forebear agreed as brothers, hence Zanhua came to attach.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong said he had sworn brotherhood with Li Zanhua's father, which brought Li Zanhua to court.

sentences.zh: 吾老矣，倘後世有守文之主，則此輩招之亦不來矣。

translations.literal: I am old; if later generations have a ruler who keeps the peace, summoning such men they also will not come.
translations.idiomatic: He said a later peaceful ruler could not summon such men again.

sentences.zh: 」由是近臣不能抗議。

translations.literal: 」Hence nearby ministers could not resist the discussion.
translations.idiomatic: 」Nearby ministers could not prevail.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以太子賓客蕭遽為戶部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: On jiazi Crown Prince Guest Xiao Sui was made Minister of Revenue and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi crown prince guest Xiao Sui retired as revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以天雄軍節度使、宋王從厚兼中書令。

translations.literal: On yichou Tianxiong Army military commissioner Song Wang Conghou was made concurrent Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Song Wang Li Conghou became concurrent secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以幽州節度使趙德鈞兼中書令。

translations.literal: On xinwei Youzhou military commissioner Zhao Dejun was made concurrent Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zhao Dejun of Youzhou became concurrent secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午朔，帝御文明殿受朝。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renwu new moon: the Emperor took the Civilized Illumination Hall to receive court.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the fifth month Mingzong held court at the Civilized Illumination Hall.

sentences.zh: 詔禁網羅、彈射、弋獵。

translations.literal: An edict forbade nets, shooting, and hunting.
translations.idiomatic: Nets, shooting, and hunting were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以二王後前詹事府司直楊延紹為右讚善大夫，仍襲封酅國公，食邑二千戶。

translations.literal: On dinghai the heir of the two sage kings, former heir-apparent household registrar Yang Yanshao, was made Right Praise-giving Grand Master, continuing enfeoffment as Duke of Xi, fief two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Yang Yanshao, heir of the two sage kings, became right praise-giving grand master and duke of Xi with two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以太子太師致仕孔卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On dingyou retired Grand Tutor Kong died—court suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou retired grand tutor Kong Xun died and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 興元奏，東、西兩川各舉兵相持。

translations.literal: Xingyuan memorialized: East and West Sichuan each raised troops and faced off.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyuan reported that eastern and western Sichuan had each raised troops and were at odds.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以文宣王四十三代孫曲阜縣主簿孔仁玉為兗州龔邱令，襲文宣公。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Kong Renyu, forty-third-generation descendant of the Duke of Culture and Propagation and registrar of Qufu county, was made magistrate of Gongqiu in Yanzhou and inherited the title Duke of Culture and Propagation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Kong Renyu, forty-third-generation descendant of the Duke of Culture and Propagation and Qufu registrar, became Gongqiu magistrate in Yan and inherited the dukedom.

sentences.zh: 戊申，襄州奏，漢江大漲，水入州城，壞民廬舍。

translations.literal: On wushen, Xiangzhou memorialized: the Han River rose greatly; water entered the prefectural city and destroyed commoners' houses.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Xiang reported the Han had flooded into the city and wrecked houses.

sentences.zh: 樞密使奏：「近知兩川交惡，如令一賊兼有兩川，撫眾守險，恐難討除，欲令王思同以興元之師伺便進取。

translations.literal: The Privy Council memorialized: "We have lately learned the two Sichuans are at enmity; if one rebel were to hold both circuits, comfort the masses and hold the passes, he would be hard to suppress—we wish Wang Sitong to lead the Xingyuan army to seize a favorable moment and advance.
translations.idiomatic: The Privy Council said: "The two Sichuans are at war; if one rebel held both, held the passes, and kept the people, he would be hard to crush—we ask Wang Sitong to lead Xingyuan troops forward when the moment is right.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: 」An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: 」The court approved.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子朔，幽州趙德鈞奏：「新開東南河，自王馬口至淤口，長一百六十五里，闊六十五步，深一丈二尺，以通漕運，舟勝千石，畫圖以獻。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renzi new moon: Youzhou's Zhao Dejun memorialized: "A new southeastern canal has been opened from Wangmakou to Yukou, one hundred sixty-five li long, sixty-five paces wide, and twelve chi deep, to carry grain transport; vessels may bear a thousand shi; a map is presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon in the sixth month Zhao Dejun of You reported a new canal from Wangmakou to Yukou—165 li, 65 paces wide, 12 chi deep—for grain transport with thousand-shi vessels, and sent a map.

sentences.zh: 」甲寅，以權知高麗國事王建為檢校太保，封高麗國王。

translations.literal: 」On jiayin, Wang Jian, acting overseer of Goryeo affairs, was made honorary Grand Mentor and enfeoffed King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: 」On jiayin Wang Jian, acting overseer of Goryeo, became honorary grand mentor and king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，衛州奏，河水壞堤，東北流入御河。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Weizhou memorialized: river water broke the dikes and flowed northeast into the Imperial Canal.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Wei reported the river had broken its dikes and poured northeast into the Imperial Canal.

sentences.zh: 戊午，荊南奏：「東川董璋領兵至漢州，西川孟知祥出兵逆戰，璋大敗，得部下人二十餘，走入東川城，尋為前陵州刺史王暉所殺，孟知祥已入梓州。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Jingnan memorialized: "Eastern Sichuan's Dong Zhang led troops to Hanzhou; western Sichuan's Meng Zhixiang sent troops to meet him in battle; Zhang was utterly defeated, taking only twenty-odd of his men; he fled into the eastern Sichuan city and was soon killed by former Ling prefect Wang Hui; Meng Zhixiang has already entered Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Jingnan reported Dong Zhang of eastern Sichuan had marched on Han; Meng Zhixiang of western Sichuan met him; Zhang was routed with only twenty-odd followers, fled into the eastern Sichuan capital, was killed by former Ling prefect Wang Hui, and Meng Zhixiang had entered Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，範延光奏曰：「孟知祥兼有兩川，彼之軍眾皆我之將士，料其外假朝廷形勢以製之，然陛下苟不能屈意招攜，彼亦無由革麵。

translations.literal: 」On xinyou, Fan Yanguang memorialized, saying: "Meng Zhixiang holds both Sichuans; his troops are all our officers; I reckon that outwardly he borrows the court's prestige to restrain them—yet if Your Majesty cannot humble yourself to win him over, he has no way to change face.
translations.idiomatic: 」On xinyou Fan Yanguang said: "Meng Zhixiang holds both circuits; his soldiers are our men; he likely uses the court's prestige outwardly—but unless Your Majesty humbles yourself to win him, he cannot reform.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「知祥予故人也，以賊臣間諜，故茲阻隔，今因而撫之，何屈意之有！

translations.literal: 」The Emperor said: "Zhixiang is an old friend of mine; rebel ministers and spies caused this estrangement; now to comfort him in the moment—what need to humble oneself!
translations.idiomatic: 」Mingzong said: "Zhixiang is my old friend; rebel spies caused the breach; to comfort him now—why humble myself!

sentences.zh: 」由是遣供奉官李瑰使西川，齎詔以賜知祥。

translations.literal: 」Thereupon an attendant envoy Li Gui was sent to western Sichuan bearing an edict to bestow on Zhixiang.
translations.idiomatic: 」He sent attendant envoy Li Gui to western Sichuan with an edict for Zhixiang.

sentences.zh: 詔以霖雨積旬，久未晴霽，京城諸司係囚，並宜釋放。

translations.literal: An edict: because rain had piled up for ten days and long failed to clear, all prisoners held by the capital offices should be released.
translations.idiomatic: An edict released all prisoners held by capital offices after ten days of rain without clearing.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以大雨未止，放朝參兩日。

translations.literal: On jiazi, because heavy rain had not ceased, court attendance was suspended for two days.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi heavy rain suspended court for two days.

sentences.zh: 洛水漲泛二丈，廬舍居民有溺死者。

translations.literal: The Luo River rose more than two zhang; houses and residents were drowned.
translations.idiomatic: The Luo rose two zhang; houses and people drowned.

sentences.zh: 以前濮州刺史武延翰為右領軍上將軍，前階州刺史王宏贄為左千牛上將軍。

translations.literal: Former Pu prefect Wu Yanhan was made Right Army senior general; former Jie prefect Wang Hongzan was made Left Palace Guard senior general.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yanhan, former Pu prefect, became right army senior general; Wang Hongzan of Jie became left palace guard senior general.

sentences.zh: 金、徐、安、潁等州大水，鎮州旱。

translations.literal: Jin, Xu, An, Ying, and other prefectures had great floods; Zhenzhou had drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jin, Xu, An, Ying, and others flooded; Zhen had drought.

sentences.zh: 詔應水旱州郡，各遣使人存問。

translations.literal: An edict ordered every prefecture and commandery suffering flood or drought to send envoys to inquire after the people.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered flood- and drought-struck prefectures to send envoys to inquire after the people.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳朔，以天下兵馬元帥、尚父、吳越國王錢鏐薨，廢朝三日。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, xinsi new moon: Qian Liu, Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses, Imperial Father, and King of Wu-Yue, died; court was suspended three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi new moon in the seventh month Qian Liu, grand marshal, imperial father, and king of Wu-Yue, died; court was suspended three days.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔賜諸軍救接錢有差。

translations.literal: On bingxu, an edict bestowed relief money on the various armies in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu relief money was graded to the armies.

sentences.zh: 戊子，正衙命使冊高麗國王王建。

translations.literal: On wuzi, envoys at the main court were ordered to invest Wang Jian as King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi main-court envoys invested Wang Jian as king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 靈武奏，夏州界党項七百騎侵擾，當道出師擊破之，生擒五十騎，追至賀蘭山下。

translations.literal: Lingwu memorialized: seven hundred Tangut horsemen on the Xiazhou border raided; the circuit sent troops and routed them, taking fifty horsemen alive and pursuing to below Helan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Lingwu reported seven hundred Tangut horsemen had raided the Xia border; circuit troops routed them, took fifty alive, and pursued to Helan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，兩浙節度使錢元尞起復，加守尚書令。

translations.literal: On jichou, Liang-Zhe military commissioner Qian Yuanying resumed office and was made acting Minister of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Qian Yuanying of Liang-Zhe resumed office and became acting minister of the imperial secretariat.

sentences.zh: 青州節度使王晏球加兼中書令。

translations.literal: Qingzhou military commissioner Wang Yanqiu was additionally made Concurrent Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanqiu of Qing was also made concurrent grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 秦、鳳、兗、宋、亳、潁、鄧大水，漂邑屋，損苗稼。

translations.literal: Qin, Feng, Yan, Song, Bo, Ying, and Deng had great floods that swept towns and houses and damaged crops.
translations.idiomatic: Qin, Feng, Yan, Song, Bo, Ying, and Deng flooded, sweeping towns and damaging crops.

sentences.zh: 夔州赤甲山崩。

translations.literal: Kuizhou's Chijia Mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Chijia Mountain in Kui collapsed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以前太僕卿鄭繢為鴻臚卿，以前兗州行軍司馬李鈴為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On renchen, former Grand Stablemaster Zheng Hui was made Director of the Court for Diplomatic Reception; former Yanzhou campaign deputy Li Ling was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Zheng Hui, former grand stablemaster, became director of diplomatic reception; Li Ling, former Yan campaign deputy, became minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 乙未，福建節度使王延鈞進絹表云：「吳越王錢鏐薨，乞封臣為吳越王。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Fujian military commissioner Wang Yanjun presented a silk memorial, saying: "King of Wu-Yue Qian Liu has died; I beg to be enfeoffed King of Wu-Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Wang Yanjun of Fujian asked by silk memorial that, Qian Liu of Wu-Yue having died, he be enfeoffed king of Wu-Yue.

sentences.zh: 湖南馬殷官是尚書令，殷薨，請授臣尚書令。

translations.literal: Hunan's Ma Yin held the post Minister of the Imperial Secretariat; Yin has died—please grant me Minister of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yin of Hunan had been minister of the imperial secretariat; with Yin dead, Yanjun asked for that post.

sentences.zh: 」不報。

translations.literal: 」No reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: 」The court did not reply.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太子賓客李光憲以禮部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Crown Prince Mentor Li Guangxian retired as Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Li Guangxian, crown prince mentor, retired as minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以前靈武節度使康福為涇州節度使。

translations.literal: On jihai, former Lingwu military commissioner Kang Fu was made Jingzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Kang Fu, former Ling commissioner, became Jing commissioner.

sentences.zh: 幽州衙將潘杲上言，知故使劉仁恭於大安山藏錢之所，樞密院差人監往發之，竟無所得。

translations.literal: Youzhou headquarters officer Pan Gao submitted word that he knew where former commissioner Liu Rengong had hidden money on Mount Da'an; the Privy Council sent men to supervise opening it, but in the end nothing was obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Gao, Youzhou headquarters officer, said he knew Liu Rengong's money cache on Mount Da'an; the Privy Council supervised digging but found nothing.

sentences.zh: 以皇子西京留守、京兆尹從珂為鳳翔節度使。

translations.literal: The imperial prince, western capital regent, and Jingzhao prefect Congke was made Fengxiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Congke, imperial prince, western capital regent, and Jingzhao prefect, became Fengxiang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 廢鳳州武興軍節制為防禦使，並所管興、文二州並依舊隸興元府。

translations.literal: Fengzhou's Wuxing Army command was abolished to defense commissioner; the Xing and Wen prefectures it governed were restored to Xingyuan prefecture as before.
translations.idiomatic: Feng's Wuxing army command became a defense post; Xing and Wen returned to Xingyuan as before.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以門下侍郎兼吏部尚書、同平章事、監修國史趙鳳為檢校太傅、同平章事，充邢州節度使。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Minister of Personnel, Grand Councilor, and supervising compiler of state history Zhao Feng was made honorary Grand Mentor and Grand Councilor, filling the post of Xingzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Zhao Feng—vice director of the secretariat, personnel minister, grand councilor, and state-history compiler—became honorary grand mentor and grand councilor at Xing.

sentences.zh: 詔諸州府遭水人戶各支借麥種及等第賑貸。

translations.literal: An edict ordered every prefecture and commandery struck by flood to lend wheat seed to households and grant graded relief loans.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered flood-hit prefectures to lend wheat seed and grant graded relief.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，青州節度使王晏球卒，廢朝二日。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinhai: Qingzhou military commissioner Wang Yanqiu died; court was suspended two days.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on xinhai Wang Yanqiu of Qing died; court was suspended two days.

sentences.zh: 以利州節度使孫漢韶兼西面行營招討使。

translations.literal: Lizhou military commissioner Sun Hanshao was additionally made western campaign suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Hanshao of Li was also made western campaign suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以前振武節度使張萬進為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiayin, former Zhenwu military commissioner Zhang Wanjin was made Dengzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Zhang Wanjin, former Zhenwu commissioner, became Deng commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，以鄆州節度使房知溫兼中書令，移鎮青州。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Yanzhou military commissioner Fang Zhiwen was additionally made Concurrent Grand Councilor and transferred to Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Fang Zhiwen of Yan was also made grand councilor and moved to Qing.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以宰臣李愚為門下侍郎、平章事、監修國史。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Chancellor Li Yu was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, and supervising compiler of state history.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Li Yu became vice director of the secretariat, grand councilor, and state-history compiler.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以湖南節度使馬希聲卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On jihai, because Hunan military commissioner Ma Xisheng died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Ma Xisheng of Hunan died and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 己卯，吐蕃遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On jimao, Tibet sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Tibet sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉朔，再遣供奉官李瑰使西川，兼押賜故福慶長公主祭贈絹三千匹，並賜知祥玉帶。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, jiyou new moon: attendant envoy Li Gui was again sent to western Sichuan, also escorting three thousand bolts of silk for funeral offerings to the late Princess of Blessing and Celebration and bestowing on Zhixiang a jade belt.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou new moon in the tenth month Li Gui was again sent to western Sichuan with three thousand bolts of silk for the late Princess of Blessing and Celebration and a jade belt for Zhixiang.

sentences.zh: 先是，兩川隔遠，朝廷兵士不下三萬人，至是，知祥上表乞發遣兵士家屬入川，詔報不允。

translations.literal: Earlier the two Sichuans were remote and court troops there were fewer than thirty thousand; now Zhixiang memorialized asking to send soldiers' families into Sichuan; an edict replied that it was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the circuits were remote and fewer than thirty thousand court troops were there; now Zhixiang asked to bring soldiers' families in; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 知祥所奏兩川部內文武將吏，乞許權行墨製除補訖奏，詔許之。

translations.literal: Zhixiang's memorial on civil and military officers within the two Sichuans asked permission to provisionally appoint by ink edict and report after the fact; an edict permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhixiang asked to appoint civil and military officers in both circuits by provisional ink edict and report afterward; the court allowed it.

sentences.zh: 知祥所奏立功大將趙季良等五人正授節鉞，續有處分。

translations.literal: Zhixiang's memorial on meritorious great generals Zhao Jiliang and four others asked regular investiture with military commissioners; further disposition would follow.
translations.idiomatic: Zhixiang asked regular commissioner seals for Zhao Jiliang and four other meritorious generals; further orders would follow.

sentences.zh: 襄州奏，漢水溢，壞民廬舍。

translations.literal: Xiangzhou memorialized: the Han River overflowed and destroyed commoners' houses.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang reported the Han had overflowed and wrecked houses.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以太常卿劉嶽卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On guichou, because Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Liu Yue died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liu Yue, director of imperial sacrifices, died and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 己未，以兵部侍郎張文寶為吏部侍郎，以戶部侍郎藥縱之為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Vice Minister of War Zhang Wenbao was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of Revenue Yao Zongzhi was made Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Zhang Wenbao became personnel vice minister; Yao Zongzhi became war vice minister.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸至德宮，因幸石敬瑭、李從昶、李從敏之第。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the Emperor visited the Palace of Highest Virtue and then visited the residences of Shi Jingtang, Li Congchang, and Li Congmin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Mingzong visited the Palace of Highest Virtue, then the homes of Shi Jingtang, Li Congchang, and Li Congmin.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大理少卿康澄上疏曰：「臣聞安危得失，治亂興亡，誠不係於天時，固非由於地利，童謠非禍福之本，妖祥豈隆替之源！

translations.literal: On renshen, Assistant Director of the Court of Judicial Review Kang Cheng submitted a memorial, saying: "Your subject has heard that safety and danger, gain and loss, order and chaos, rise and fall truly do not depend on heavenly timing and surely are not due to earthly advantage; children's rhymes are not the root of fortune and disaster, and strange omens are hardly the source of ascent and decline!
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Kang Cheng, assistant director of judicial review, wrote: "Safety and danger, order and chaos, do not hang on heaven or earth; rhymes are not fortune's root and omens are not fate's source!

sentences.zh: 故雊雉升鼎而桑穀生朝，不能止殷宗之盛；

translations.literal: Thus when a crowing pheasant mounted the tripod and mulberry and grain grew in the court, they could not stop the Yin ancestor's flourishing;
translations.idiomatic: A crowing pheasant on the tripod and mulberry grain in court did not stop the Yin ancestor's rise;

sentences.zh: 神馬長嘶而玉龜告兆，不能延晉祚之長。

translations.literal: when a divine horse neighed long and a jade tortoise announced a portent, they could not extend Jin's mandate long.
translations.idiomatic: a divine horse's long neigh and a jade tortoise's omen did not lengthen Jin's mandate.

sentences.zh: 是知國家有不足懼者五，有深可畏者六。

translations.literal: Thus one knows the state has five things not worth fearing and six things deeply to be feared.
translations.idiomatic: The state has five things not worth fearing and six deeply to be feared.

sentences.zh: 陰陽不調不足懼，三辰失行不足懼，小人訛言不足懼，山崩川涸不足懼，蟊賊傷稼不足懼，此不足懼者五也。

translations.literal: Yin and yang out of tune is not worth fearing; the three luminaries off course is not worth fearing; petty men's false words are not worth fearing; mountains collapsing and rivers drying are not worth fearing; locusts harming crops is not worth fearing—these are the five not worth fearing.
translations.idiomatic: Discord of yin and yang, errant stars, petty lies, collapsed mountains and dry rivers, and locusts in the fields are not worth fearing—these five.

sentences.zh: 賢人藏匿深可畏，四民遷業深可畏，上下相徇深可畏，廉恥道消深可畏，毀譽亂真深可畏，直言蔑聞深可畏，此深可畏者六也。

translations.literal: Worthies in hiding is deeply to be feared; the four classes changing trades is deeply to be feared; superiors and inferiors covering for each other is deeply to be feared; the way of integrity and shame fading is deeply to be feared; slander and praise confusing truth is deeply to be feared; straight words scorned and unheard is deeply to be feared—these are the six deeply to be feared.
translations.idiomatic: Hidden worthies, trades abandoned, mutual cover between high and low, faded integrity, slander confusing truth, and straight counsel ignored—these six are deeply to be feared.

sentences.zh: 伏惟陛下尊臨萬國，奄有八紘，蕩三季之澆風，振百王之舊典，設四科而羅俊彥，提二柄而禦英雄。

translations.literal: I bow before Your Majesty, honored above ten thousand states, holding the eight directions, sweeping the decadent winds of three degenerate ages, reviving the old canons of a hundred kings, setting the four categories to gather the outstanding, and wielding the two handles to control heroes.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty rules ten thousand states and the eight directions, sweeps three ages of decadence, revives a hundred kings' canons, sets four categories to gather talent, and wields two handles to control heroes.

sentences.zh: 所以不軌不物之徒，咸思革麵；

translations.literal: Therefore those outside the track and outside the norm all wish to change face;
translations.idiomatic: Those outside the track and norm all wish to reform;

sentences.zh: 無禮無儀之輩，相率悛心。

translations.literal: the ranks without rites and without ceremony one after another repent their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: the rude and unmannered repent in succession.

sentences.zh: 然而不足懼者，願陛下存而勿論；

translations.literal: Yet as to what is not worth fearing, I wish Your Majesty to keep it and not discuss it;
translations.idiomatic: What is not worth fearing, may Your Majesty keep and pass over;

sentences.zh: 深可畏者，願陛下修而靡忒。

translations.literal: what is deeply to be feared, I wish Your Majesty to cultivate it without deviation.
translations.idiomatic: what is deeply to be feared, may Your Majesty cultivate without wavering.

sentences.zh: 加以崇三綱五常之教，敷六府三事之歌，則鴻基與五嶽爭高，盛業共磐石永固。

translations.literal: Add to this exalting the teaching of the three bonds and five constants and spreading the song of the six storehouses and three affairs, then the great foundation will vie in height with the five peaks and the flourishing enterprise will be firm as bedrock forever.
translations.idiomatic: Exalt the three bonds and five constants and spread the song of the six storehouses and three affairs, and the foundation will rival the five peaks and the enterprise stand firm as bedrock.

sentences.zh: 」優詔獎之。

translations.literal: 」A gracious edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: 」A gracious edict praised him.

sentences.zh: 澄言可畏六事，實中當時之病，識者許之。

translations.literal: Cheng's six fearful matters truly hit the sickness of the time; the knowing approved.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng's six fears struck the age's sickness; critics approved.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，湖南馬希範、荊南高從誨並進銀及茶，乞賜戰馬，帝還其直，各賜馬有差。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Hunan's Ma Xifan and Jingnan's Gao Conghui each presented silver and tea and begged battle horses; the Emperor returned their price and bestowed horses in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Ma Xifan of Hunan and Gao Conghui of Jingnan offered silver and tea for war horses; Mingzong returned the price and gave horses in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，帝謂範延光曰：「如聞禁軍戍守，多不稟藩臣之命，緩急如何驅使？

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Emperor said to Fan Yanguang: "I hear that when the imperial guard garrisons, many do not obey the circuit commissioner's orders—in urgency how can they be driven?
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Mingzong told Fan Yanguang: "Garrison guards often ignore circuit commissioners—how drive them in crisis?

sentences.zh: 」延光曰：「承前禁軍出戍，便令逐處守臣管轄斷決，近似簡易。

translations.literal: 」Yanguang said: "Following precedent, when the imperial guard goes out to garrison, the local defending commissioner is put in charge of judgment and decision—nearly simple.
translations.idiomatic: 」Yanguang said: "By precedent garrison guards on duty were judged by local defenders—nearly simple.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「速以宣命條舉之。」

translations.literal: 」The Emperor said: "Quickly draw up an edict in items and present it."
translations.idiomatic: 」Mingzong said: "Draw up an edict at once."

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，以三司使、左武衛大將軍孟鵠為許州節度使，以前許州節度使馮贇為宣徽使、判三司，以宣徽北院使孟漢瓊判院事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinsi: Revenue Commissioner and Left Martial Guard senior general Meng He was made Xuzhou military commissioner; former Xuzhou military commissioner Feng Yun was made Palace Treasury Commissioner and overseer of the Revenue Commission; Palace Treasury north-yard commissioner Meng Hanqiong was made deputy commissioner of the yard.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the eleventh month Meng He, revenue commissioner and left martial guard senior general, became Xu commissioner; Feng Yun, former Xu commissioner, became palace treasury commissioner and revenue overseer; Meng Hanqiong of the north yard became deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，史館奏：「宣宗已下四廟未有實錄，請下兩浙、荊湖購募野史及除目報狀。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Historiographic Office memorialized: "From Emperor Xuanzong down, the four temple veritable records do not yet exist; we beg orders to Liang-Zhe and Jing-Hu to purchase unofficial histories and appointment reports.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Historiographic Office said: "From Xuanzong onward the four temple veritable records are missing; we ask Liang-Zhe and Jing-Hu to buy unofficial histories and appointment reports.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （：《五代會要》載十一月四日，史館奏：當館昨為大中以來，迄於天祐，四朝實錄，尚未纂修，尋具奏聞，謹行購募。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 records: on the fourth day of the eleventh month the Historiographic Office memorialized: "This office, for the four reign veritable records from the Dazhong era through Tianyou, has not yet compiled them; we have already memorialized and respectfully undertake procurement.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says: on the fourth of the eleventh month the Historiographic Office reported that veritable records from Dazhong through Tianyou were still uncompiled and procurement had begun.

sentences.zh: 敕命雖頒於數月，圖書未貢於一編。

translations.literal: Though the edict was issued months ago, not one compilation of books has been presented.
translations.idiomatic: Months after the edict, not one book had arrived.

sentences.zh: 蓋以北土州城，久罹兵火，遂成滅絕，難可訪求。

translations.literal: This is because northern prefectures and cities long suffered war and fire until extinction, hard to seek out.
translations.idiomatic: Northern cities had long burned in war and sources were gone.

sentences.zh: 切恐歲月漸深，耳目不接，長為闕典，過在攸司。

translations.literal: I fear that as years deepen and witnesses are cut off, it will long be a missing canon—the fault lies in this office.
translations.idiomatic: Years would sever witnesses and leave a lasting gap—the office was at fault.

sentences.zh: 伏念江表列藩，湖南奧壞，至於閩、越，方屬勳賢。

translations.literal: I reflect that the Yangtze circuits, Hunan's rich region, and as for Min and Yue, are now held by meritorious worthies.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangtze circuits, rich Hunan, and Min and Yue were held by meritorious lords.

sentences.zh: 戈鋌自擾於中原，屏翰悉全於外府，固多奇士，富有群書。

translations.literal: Weapons have troubled the central plain while screen defenders remain whole in outer prefectures—surely many unusual scholars and rich collections of books.
translations.idiomatic: War had ravaged the center while outer prefectures stood intact, with scholars and books in plenty.

sentences.zh: 其兩浙、福建、湖廣伏乞詔旨，委各於本道采訪宣宗、懿宗、僖宗、昭宗以上四朝野史，及逐朝日曆、銀台事宜、內外製詞、百司沿革簿籍，不限卷數，據有者抄錄上進。

translations.literal: For Liang-Zhe, Fujian, and Huguang I beg an edict commissioning each circuit to seek unofficial histories of the four reigns from Xuanzong, Yizong, Xizong, and Zhaozong upward, and each reign's calendars, Silver Terrace affairs, inner and outer edicts, and hundred-office evolution registers, without limit on juan—copy and submit what exists.
translations.idiomatic: For Liang-Zhe, Fujian, and Huguang it asked edicts to seek from Xuanzong through Zhaozong unofficial histories, calendars, Silver Terrace records, edicts, and office registers, copying all held copies.

sentences.zh: 若民間收得，或隱士撰成，即令各列姓名，請議爵賞。）〉

translations.literal: If the people have recovered them or recluses have compiled them, let each list his name and request rank and reward.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Private finds or recluse compilations should list names for rank and reward.)〉

sentences.zh: 癸未，以左僕射致仕鄭玨卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On guiwei, because Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Zheng Jue, retired, died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Zheng Jue, retired left vice director, died and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以河陽節度使兼六軍諸衛副使石敬瑭為河東節度使，兼大同、彰國、振武、威塞等軍蕃漢馬步總管。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Heyang military commissioner and deputy overall commander of the Six Army guards Shi Jingtang was made Hedong military commissioner and overall commander of Tangut and Han horse and foot of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Shi Jingtang of Heyang, deputy Six Armies commander, became Hedong commissioner and overall Tangut-Han commander of Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies.

sentences.zh: 時契丹帳族在雲州境上，與群臣議擇威望大臣以製北方，故有是命。

translations.literal: At the time Khitan tent clans were on the Yunzhou border; with the hundred officials he discussed choosing a minister of prestige to control the north—hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan tents were on the Yun border; ministers chose a prestigious northward commander—hence the order.

sentences.zh: 己丑，樞密使趙延壽加同平章事。

translations.literal: On jichou, Privy Council commissioner Zhao Yanshou was additionally made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Zhao Yanshou of the Privy Council was also made grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 詔在京臣僚，不得進奉賀長至馬及諸物。

translations.literal: An edict: capital officials may not present tribute horses or other goods for congratulating the winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict barred capital officials from solstice tribute horses or goods.

sentences.zh: 甲午，日南至，帝御文明殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the winter solstice: the Emperor held court at the Hall of Civilization and received congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the solstice, Mingzong received congratulations at the Hall of Civilization.

sentences.zh: 己亥，河中節度使李從璋加檢校太傅，以右散騎常侍楊凝式為工部侍郎。

translations.literal: On jihai, Hezhong military commissioner Li Congzhang was made honorary Grand Mentor; Right Regular Attendant Yang Ningshi was made Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Li Congzhang of Hezhong became honorary grand mentor; Yang Ningshi became works vice minister.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以秘書監盧文紀為工部尚書，以工部尚書崔居儉為太常卿，以工部侍郎鄭韜光為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Director of the Secretariat Lu Wenji was made Minister of Works; Minister of Works Cui Jujian was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Vice Minister of Works Zheng Taoguang was made Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Lu Wenji became works minister; Cui Jujian became sacrifices director; Zheng Taoguang became rites vice minister.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，雲州奏，契丹主在黑榆林南捺剌泊造攻城之具。

translations.literal: On yisi, Yunzhou memorialized: the Khitan ruler south of Black Willow Forest at Nalabo was making siege engines.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Yun reported the Khitan ruler was building siege engines south of Black Willow Forest at Nalabo.

sentences.zh: 帝遣使賜契丹主銀器彩帛。

translations.literal: The Emperor sent envoys to bestow silver vessels and colored silks on the Khitan ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong sent silver vessels and silks to the Khitan ruler.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申朔，供奉官丁延徽、倉官田繼勳並棄市，坐擅出倉粟數百斛故也。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wushen new moon: attendant official Ding Yanhui and granary officer Tian Jixun were both executed in the market for having unauthorizedly issued several hundred hu of granary grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen new moon in the twelfth month Ding Yanhui and granary officer Tian Jixun were executed for issuing hundreds of hu of grain without authority.

sentences.zh: 教坊伶官敬新磨受賄，為人告，帝令御史台征還其錢而後撻之。

translations.literal: Music-office performer Jing Xinmo took bribes; someone reported it; the Emperor ordered the Censorate to recover the money and then flog him.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Xinmo of the music office took bribes; Mingzong had the censorate recover the cash and then flog him.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，幸龍門，觀修伊水石堰，賜丁夫酒食。

translations.literal: On guichou, the Emperor visited Longmen to view repairs on the Yi River stone weir and bestowed wine and food on the laborers.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Mingzong visited Longmen to view the Yi River weir and fed the laborers.

sentences.zh: 後數日，有司奏：「丁夫役限十五日已滿，工未畢，請更役五日。

translations.literal: Several days later the relevant office memorialized: "The laborers' term of fifteen days is full but the work is not finished; we beg five more days of service.
translations.idiomatic: Days later the office said: "Laborers' fifteen-day term is up but work remains; we ask five more days.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「不惟時寒，且不可失信於小民。

translations.literal: 」The Emperor said: "Not only is the season cold, but one also cannot break faith with the common people.
translations.idiomatic: 」Mingzong said: "It is cold, and we cannot break faith with commoners.

sentences.zh: 」即止其役。

translations.literal: 」The labor was stopped at once.
translations.idiomatic: 」The labor stopped at once.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以太子賓客歸藹卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On jiayin, because Crown Prince Mentor Gui Ai died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Gui Ai, crown prince mentor, died and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以前宣徽使朱宏昭為襄州節度使；

translations.literal: On wuwu, former Palace Treasury Commissioner Zhu Hongzhao was made Xiangzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Zhu Hongzhao, former palace treasury commissioner, became Xiang commissioner;

sentences.zh: 康義誠為河陽節度使，充侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Kang Yicheng was made Heyang military commissioner, appointed commander-in-chief of the Palace Guard personal army horse and foot.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Yicheng became Heyang commissioner and commander of the palace guard horse and foot.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以吏部侍郎姚顗為尚書左丞，以尚書左丞王權為禮部尚書，以兵部侍郎藥縱之為吏部侍郎，以翰林學士、中書舍人程遜為戶部侍郎，依前充職。

translations.literal: On renxu, Vice Minister of Personnel Yao Yi was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Left Vice Director Wang Quan was made Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of War Yao Zongzhi was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Hanlin academician and Secretariat drafting officer Cheng Xun was made Vice Minister of Revenue, continuing in his charge.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Yao Yi of personnel became left vice director; Wang Quan of the left vice directorate became rites minister; Yao Zongzhi of war became personnel vice minister; and Cheng Xun, Hanlin scholar and secretariat drafter, became revenue vice minister while keeping his concurrent charge.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，帝畋於近郊，射中奔鹿。

translations.literal: On wuchen the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs and shot a running deer.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Mingzong hunted in the near suburbs and shot a running deer.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter brought no snow.
